integrity: The bitset recurrence is proved exhaustive and computed with unbounded integer precision. All required published results are credited; the package includes a standalone verifier, full 175-member maximal-length list, and replay output.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite statement for n=1..12 only; not an asymptotic formula. Full text of two earlier Yokota papers could not be obtained, creating residual originality-access uncertainty.
title: The first eight-term threshold for sums of distinct factorial divisors
